about_the_game:
Rouletum is a Balatro-like game based on roulette and the use of mystical powers to tilt the odds in your favor.

This demo will show you the full depth of Rouletum's future gameplay:
• 3 floors of the Rouletum casino;

• 9 Bosses changing the field and gameplay + 1 secret boss;

• 20 under-the table chips that allow you to create unique builds;

• 10 sigils that give a powerfull but single-use effect on the game;

In the full version you will get all 9 floors of the Rouletum casino as well as even more under-the-table chips,sigils and bosses.

🎯 A Million-to-One Chance

The mysterious owner of the Rouletum casino has announced his desire to retire. This roulette-loving, extravagant millionaire seeks a successor — someone who can win at every table in his casino, even against him. Will you be the one to claim the grand prize?

🎲 Under-the-table Chips

Mystical under-the-table chips sold by a shady merchant — what secrets do they hold? Use the powers of special casino chips to influence odds, winning multipliers, and many other aspects of the game. Give yourself some passive advantage!

🔮 Sigils

Occult seals powerful enough to drastically change the game. They alter the board, disrupt bosses, and shift the flow of play in your favor. Their power is strong but short-lived — use them wisely.

👑 Bosses

The casino floors of Rouletum are ruled by skilled, cunning, and powerful bosses — slaves and workers of the casino who want only one thing: your defeat. Win against a randomly selected casino representative: outsmart their unique rules, survive their supernatural tricks, and climb higher!

  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7, 8, 10, 11 | x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i3
  • Graphics: OpenGL 2.1 compatible graphics card, integrated graphics
  • Storage: 300 MB available space

short_description: Roulette-based rogue-like with a bit of supernatural. Place your bets, use under-the-table chips and mystical sigils to claim your prize. Using your wits, a TON of luck and some help from strange places you can rise to the top of the Rouletum Casino!
